criteria.description: Players can be added, renamed, recoloured and deleted, and the changes are saved
criteria.verification: player-store.test.ts: each change is seen by a new store on the same storage

criteria.description: Groups can be created, edited and deleted, and the changes are saved; deleting a player removes it from groups
Saved data carries a version number and old versions run through migrations on load
criteria.verification: migrate.test.ts: test migration table v1 -> v3; saved JSON has version

criteria.description: Blocked or failing storage never crashes; the app works for the session and shows a notice
criteria.verification: safe-storage/player-store tests with throwing backends; manual check of the notice

criteria.description: Bad saved data never crashes; good entries are kept, broken ones dropped
A phone-friendly screen manages players and groups (portrait, tap targets at least 48 px)
criteria.verification: manual: npm run dev at 390 px wide, all actions work, reload keeps data

criteria.description: Typecheck, tests and build pass locally and in CI on the PR
criteria.verification: npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build; gh pr checks
